latestText: Went into the Music Shop. Bell jingled. Played my piano. Got a few keys sounding good together. A chord. Played it again. Feel good.

recentDiary.text: Went into the Music Shop. Bell jingled. Played my piano. Got a few keys sounding good together. A chord. Played it again. Feel good.
Sat in the chair at the desk. Used the computer. Looked up what to do when bored. Saw a saved favorite: GitHub, account kittyxero. Feel good.
Looked up what to do when bored in the browser. One page said to doodle without a plan and to do a single slow stretch.
Rested a bit. I was not tired. I feel okay. A bit bored. Don't know what next.
Explored again. Found nothing new. Feel good. Still curious. Not sure where to go next.

pieces.title: Small Piano Piece
pieces.text: Low note. High note. Low note again. Then I stopped.

pieces.title: Small thing I made

pieces.title: Small Tune
pieces.text: Played a few notes on the piano. Played them again. They sounded good.
